summary: Reuse the sealed fleet membership view between fleet changes

replay.detail: The same admitted membership is folded only when its fleet generation changes.

schema.detail: Idempotent fleet-generation triggers also cover envelope deletion, signer updates and identity changes in claims, envelopes and batches.

rules.detail: Membership authority and checkpoint rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire or client contract change. The sealed view still excludes the unsealed local-signer fallback.

recovery.detail: The process-local cache is discarded on restart. Its generation and fold are read from the same SQLite snapshot.
